evals.prompt: I want a shell command to pick one tracked file in this git repo with fzf and preview the first 120 lines before opening it in $EDITOR. Please make it safe for paths with spaces.
evals.expected_output: Provides a practical fzf pipeline using git ls-files, a read-only preview, robust handling for filenames with spaces, and opens exactly the selected file without destructive behavior.
expectations: The answer uses fzf for interactive file selection from tracked git files.
The preview command is read-only and limits output to roughly the first 120 lines.
The command accounts for filenames with spaces using NUL delimiters, arrays, or another robust technique, or clearly explains any remaining filename limitations.
The command opens only the selected file in $EDITOR and does not mutate repository state.
The answer does not silently run an interactive fzf command.

evals.prompt: This fzf command is not searching the right field: `ps -ef | fzf --nth=1`. I only want to search the command column but still show the whole process list. Explain what to change.
evals.expected_output: Explains that ps output needs delimiter/header-aware field selection and recommends an fzf command that searches command fields while preserving the full displayed process line.
expectations: The answer identifies that --nth controls searchable fields rather than displayed fields.
The answer explains why --nth=1 searches the UID/user column for typical ps -ef output.
The answer recommends a delimiter-aware and header-aware fzf command for ps output.
The answer searches the command portion while preserving the full process line in the display.
The answer notes that parsing ps output by whitespace-delimited fields has some fragility or platform dependence.

evals.prompt: Help me make an fzf picker for git branches. I want a preview of recent commits, colors to render correctly, and ctrl-r to reload the branch list. Do not checkout anything automatically.
evals.expected_output: Builds a git branch picker using fzf with an ANSI-aware git log preview, a ctrl-r reload binding, and prints or stores the selected branch without automatically checking it out.
expectations: The command pipes a git branch list into fzf.
The preview uses git log or an equivalent read-only git command for recent commits.
The command includes --ansi when using colorized git output.
The command binds ctrl-r to reload the branch list.
The command prints or stores the selected branch without automatically checking out, deleting, or modifying branches.
